name: 00Food: AI Food Companion
subtitle: Bring your own AI agent
promotionalText: Your food log. Your AI agent. Connect your own agent to estimate foods, build your library, and review your day. ChatGPT Work is recommended for automatic responses.
description:
00Food is an iPhone food log built for you and your AI agent.

Connect your favourite compatible MCP agent to estimate foods from descriptions or photos and help you review your day. You approve the estimates and build your own reusable food library. 00Food has no built-in food catalogue or bundled AI agent.

BRING YOUR OWN AGENT
Connect your agent using the MCP address in the app. Your agent reads a food description and any attached photo, proposes a rough estimate with an explanation, and sends it back for your review. Approved foods become part of your personal library for quick repeat logging. You can always enter calories manually.

LET YOUR AGENT FOLLOW ALONG
MCP Events lets your agent respond when you request an estimate, add context, or request a daily review, without you asking it to check each time. ChatGPT Work is the recommended setup for this workflow. Use a Work chat on ChatGPT web, or Work with Cloud selected in the desktop app. Connect the 00Food MCP server as a plugin, then ask your agent to subscribe to events. Connecting alone does not enable automatic responses. Other compatible MCP agents can check pending requests when you ask them. Your AI service's availability and access requirements apply.

KEEP A PICTURE OF YOUR DAY
Log your saved foods with one tap, track water and fruit-and-vegetable portions, and compare logged calories with your rough daily allowance. Optional Apple Health integration adds activity, weight, body-fat history, and water. A Home Screen widget keeps your daily balance close at hand.

CHOOSE WHAT TO SHARE
Your agent receives only the permissions you approve. Daily reviews are optional and use food logs and available Health summaries shared at your request. You review food estimates before they are saved or logged.

00Food uses rough estimates to support reflection. It is not a medical service, and its calorie figures and progress illustrations are not clinical predictions.
whatsNew: 00Food now makes the agent partnership clear from the start: a new tagline, guided ChatGPT Work setup, copyable agent instructions, and separate connection and event-subscription status. Your food library grows from estimates you approve, with manual logging always available.
